stem: On average, 1 in 150 components made by a certain machine are faulty. The random variable $X$ denotes the number of faulty components in a random sample of 500 components.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State a suitable approximating distribution for $X$, giving a justification for your choice.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Use your approximating distribution to find the probability that the sample will include at least 3 faulty components.
